statement: For n≥3, the maximum generic complex planar realization count of an n-vertex Laman graph, modulo translations and rotations with reflections distinct, satisfies M2(n)≥2·2^((n−3) mod 15)·976908^floor((n−3)/15).

answer.text: M2(n)≥2·2^((n−3) mod 15)·976908^floor((n−3)/15), with growth base approximately 2.50798.

The construction glues eighteen-vertex graphs with 1,953,816 realizations along a triangle. Its exponential growth base is 976908^(1/15)≈2.50798.
scope: Generic complex realizations of minimally rigid planar graphs with n vertices, maximized over the graph.
